tools.name: check_disposable_email
tools.description: Checks whether an email address or domain belongs to a known disposable/temporary email provider (mailinator.com, 10minutemail.com, etc). Returns { domain, disposable, source }.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_disposable_email · Public sink: check_disposable_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_disposable_email · Public sink: check_disposable_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
